title: Baattuu Mallattoo Sagal
intro: Fakkiin tokko jalqaba gad of deebisu irraa ka’e, hiree fedha waaqaatiin barreeffame qaba. Daa’imummaatti dhokattee dallaa bulchaa uummata isaanii balleessuuf barbaade sana keessa guddattee lubbuun kun dhuma irratti ergama guddaa tokkoof waamamte. Amantii fi ulee tiksee gad of deebisu malee homaa kan hin hidhanne siʼa taʼu, bulchaa bara sanaa isa hunda caalaa humna guddaa qabu dura dhaabbatanii warra garboomfaman bilisummaa gaafatan. Addunyaan mataan ishee ajaja isaaniitiin waan socho’u fakkaata ture — bishaan addaan ba’e, samiin ni dubbate, mootummaan tokkos ni kufe.
clues: Guyyoonni koo jalqabaa sodaadhaan kan beekaman turan — daa’imman akka koo yeroo dhalatan bulchaa gara laafina hin qabne kan egeree sodaatuun adamfamaniiru.
Bishaan baraaramee masaraa bulchaa isa badiisa koo barbaade sanaa keessa guddadhe.
Biyya fagootti tiksee gad of deebisu taʼee, taatee akka tasaa erga mudateen booda biyya kootii baqadheen baʼe.
Bulchaa humna guddaa qabu sana ulee salphaa fi ergaa ifa ta’een, bilisummaa saba koo gaafachuun fuulduratti deebi’e.
Warra na hordofaniif bishaan guddaa addaan qoodeen, bishaan sun diina koo guutummaatti yeroo liqimsan ilaalaa ture.
Rabbiin irraa qajeelfama waaqaa argachuuf gaara qulqulluu tokko ol bahee, ragaa dhugaa ta’ee mallattoo ifa ta’e sagal naaf kenname.

outcome.answer: Ummata koo bishaan addaan ba'e qaxxaamuree gara bilisummaatti geesse

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ تِسْعَ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍۢ ۖ فَسْـَٔلْ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِذْ جَآءَهُمْ فَقَالَ لَهُۥ فِرْعَوْنُ إِنِّى لَأَظُنُّكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ مَسْحُورًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, "Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic." (17:101)
